```yaml
name: Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build docs
        run: npm run build:docs

      - name: Upload docs artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-build
          path: docs/build

  deploy-docs:
    needs: build-docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.repository == 'NVIDIA/NemoClaw'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Download docs artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-build

      - name: Deploy to gh-pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: docs/build
          commit-message: "Deploy docs for PR #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
```
This GitHub Actions workflow splits the original docs preview workflow into two separate workflows: one for building the docs and uploading them as an artifact (`docs-preview-pr.yaml`), and another for deploying the artifact to `gh-pages` (`docs-preview-deploy.yaml`). The `deploy-docs` job is triggered by either a manual dispatch or when the `build-docs` job completes successfully. It ensures that only same-repo PRs are deployed to `gh-pages`, enhancing security.
